name: The Kiln Matron
description: an old imp crone of the Ember Wastes who bakes the Heat Stairs: a tall bony hunched imp with wrinkled dark crimson skin, long drooping horns hung with little iron charms, a stained leather baker's apron glowing with heat, a long iron oven peel held like a staff, a hot lavender glow in her eyes, ragged bat wings, a bun of smoke

poses.stand: hovering hunched on ragged bat wings, leaning on the long iron oven peel, apron glowing
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers hunched, tapping the peel, her apron glowing and dimming like an oven

attack.action: raises the oven peel and flings a fan of hot embers off it forward to the right, cackling

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
